verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents fraud-review APIs, decisions, webhooks and a marketing tagline for "Return Insights" offering "actionable intelligence". Nothing states that the product generates AI-driven insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The Return Insights line is a one-line product label with no description of AI generation or in-product suggestion behavior, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
